test: Prescott et al. 2024 tonic-dopamine sweep against the extended GPR

parameter_source.weights_and_thresholds: Girard et al., 'Integration of navigation and action selection functionalities in a computational model of cortico-basal ganglia-thalamo-cortical loops', arXiv cs/0601004, Table 5 and Equations 5-14
parameter_source.gating_constant_c: 0.169, Prescott et al. 2024, Biomimetics 9(3):139 section 3.1.2 (CC BY)
parameter_source.note: docs/research/ names the model and the sweep but restates neither the weights nor the thresholds. They were located by search after a first reimplementation from recalled equations failed this sweep.

protocol.noise: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck, sigma 0.10, tau 2 s -- salience fluctuating on a BEHAVIOURAL timescale. An earlier run used 50 Hz white noise and produced 825 switches in 120 s, about 7 per second, which measured the noise rather than the model.
protocol.caveat: DISEMBODIED. The published counts come from a robot foraging task; the corpus itself notes clean selection is lower disembodied (73-81%) than embodied (89-95%). Absolute switching counts are therefore not directly comparable -- the task differs.

reproduced: the immobility gradient: 93 s at lambda 0.03, 59 s at 0.06, 0.8 s at 0.12, 0.1 s from 0.20 -- monotonic and in the published direction
clean selection at baseline dopamine with separated saliences
stability at zero salience (the earlier implementation oscillated)
not_reproduced: the switching ratio is inverted: 0.3x from baseline to lambda 0.43 against a published ~3x

GPR dithers LESS than the winner-take-all here (41 against 146); the published result is the opposite (21.3 against 9.2). This is the counterintuitive published finding and it does not come out. The task differs from the published robot foraging task, which may be sufficient explanation, but it is not demonstrated to be.
errors_found_and_corrected: the striatum was driven by cortex rather than by salience directly. Equation 14 gives the cortex input as the thalamic return ALONE, with salience entering the striatum and STN directly (Eq 5, 6, 8). Driving the striatum from cortex saturated it at 1.0 for every competitive channel and destroyed all downstream discrimination.

the output-function slopes are not all 1: TRN is 0.5 and the ventrolateral thalamus 0.62, and that 0.62 is what holds the cortico-thalamic loop gain below one. Assuming m=1 put the loop exactly at the boundary of instability and the module oscillated at zero input.
tau 40 ms -> 25 ms; STN->EP/SNr 0.9 -> 0.8; GP->EP/SNr 0.3 -> 0.4; TRN->VL 0.4 -> 0.13; gating constant c 0.2 -> 0.169
claim: Instrumented simulation diagnostics with published parameters. The selection mechanism and its dopamine dependence reproduce in direction; the switching-rate comparison does not, and the module should not be treated as validated until it does or until the discrepancy is shown to be the task.
